SELECT
FROM sys_dict WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT dict_type AS dictType, FIRST_VALUE(remark) OVER (PARTITION BY dict_type ORDER BY sort_order ASC) AS remark, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeCount FROM sys_dict
AND dict_type = #{dictType}
AND dict_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_dict t2 WHERE t2.dict_type = sys_dict.dict_type AND t2.status = 'ACTIVE')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_dict t2 WHERE t2.dict_type = sys_dict.dict_type AND t2.status = 'ACTIVE')
GROUP BY dict_type ORDER BY dict_type ASC
